query:
SELECT nh.id, nh.email, nh.first_name, nh.last_name, nh.onboarding_status, nh.created_at,
  COUNT(fs.id) as form_count,
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT fs.form_type ORDER BY fs.form_type) as forms,
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT fs.status ORDER BY fs.status) as form_statuses
FROM new_hires nh
LEFT JOIN form_submissions fs ON fs.new_hire_id = nh.id
GROUP BY nh.id
ORDER BY nh.created_at DESC
LIMIT 20;
